stemMd: What is 0.00048 written in scientific notation?
explanationMd: Scientific notation uses a coefficient at least one and less than ten. Moving the decimal four places right gives 4.8, so compensate with 10⁻⁴. Equivalent unnormalized products are not the requested notation.

distractorRationale.e: This has the same value but is not normalized scientific notation because the coefficient exceeds ten.
distractorRationale.d: This is ten times too large.
distractorRationale.a: This reverses the sign of the exponent.
distractorRationale.c: This has the same value but its coefficient is below one, so it is not normalized scientific notation.
